correctness.rationale: Commutation as partial maps makes the domain a union of full permutation cycles. Each active source cycle maps bijectively onto a cycle of the same length, with one of ell possible phases; different sources have different targets. A directed cycle of cycle labels prevents nilpotence regardless of its phases. A path on j labels vanishes at power j and contributes j−1 arrows, each of point rank ell. Including singleton paths, the j! linear orders on a j-set cancel the exponential generating-function denominator, giving exactly the stated factors. A forest on m labels with k paths of size at most h exists exactly for k ≤ m ≤ hk, proving the sharp support and including h=1. Unbounded ordered-block enumeration gives the stated Lah coefficients. A direct check on two 2-cycles gives 1+4T² at h=2; in the four-2-cycle example, the one-edge and two-disjoint-edge forests contribute 24T² and 48T⁴, and paths of three and four labels add 96T⁴ and 192T⁶ at their respective cutoffs. This recovers all stated sample strata. The frozen checker.py (lines 32–124, 127–170) supplies a separate executable replay specification; it was inspected, not executed. Finite checks do not substitute for the all-cycle-type proof.
